Subject: Follow-up on Project Submission Deadline

Hi [Name],

I noticed that the project submission was missed. As this has happened recently, I’d like to schedule a brief meeting to discuss what might be causing these delays and how we can support you in meeting future deadlines.

It is important that we align on expectations to ensure your continued success here. Please let me know when you are available to chat.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
